Name: Additional Colored Rabbits
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
What this Mod does
Adds the following new bunnies:
- black
- chocolate (dark brown)
- moorit (reddish brown)
- grey (dark grey)
- light grey
Adds the following new wool and fabric:
- black
- dark grey
- light grey
- chocolate (dark brown)
- moorit (reddish brown)
Changes the rabbit-icon in Marnies Shop to show the vanilla and the black rabbits.
Makes all rabbits able to give birth.
Adds messages for when a new rabbit baby has been born.

Downloads.Description: Implemented Bugfix for the Lightgrey Rabbit's Foot

Manifest.Name: Additional Colored Rabbits
Manifest.Description: Adds rabbits in new colors plus their wool and fabric. Does not recolor the original rabbits and objects except for the icon in Marnie's shop.
